serverInfo.name: arif-fazil-federation
serverInfo.description: MCP gateway for the arifOS federation — governed AI tools under F1-F13 constitutional floors. Read-only public tools; mutation requires SCT.

tools.name: search_federation
tools.description: Search the arifOS federation for content matching a query. Returns ranked list of surfaces with title, URL, and snippet.

tools.name: fetch_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a published article by path.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: List the six federation missions (Investigate, Interpret, Decide, Build, Monitor, Remember) and their associated surfaces.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all federation subdomains and their roles in the arifOS organ topology.

authentication.note: Public read-only tools require no auth. Mutation tools require SCT (Session Capability Token). OAuth 2.1 + PKCE available for gated access. See RFC 9728/8414/8707 well-knowns.

discovery.note: SEP-1649/1960 server card — draft, not yet in core MCP spec. Future-proofing. Clients that don't support discovery skip this probe.
